submitted.rationale: Index 18 (Cu0.26Sb0.74) had the highest EQE of the three measured: 0.0132%. That is about 3.6x the 0.0037% at index 16, which is near single-phase CuSb2O6. XRD shows CuSb2O6 across indices 13 to 16 and a mix of CuSb2O6 and Sb oxide by index 20. Index 18 sits between those two points, where CuSb2O6 probably starts to mix with Sb oxide; it was not scanned. The Cu-rich side (index 7) gave essentially zero EQE.
